column1: # Rule: the built-in fx-map patterns, at local coordinates x, y in (-1, 1] of the pattern's box, r = sqrt(x^2 + y^2),
# variation v limited to 0..1 (waves: not limited). S(t) = 3t^2 - 2t^3 on t limited to 0..1, F(t, s) = 1 - S(t/s) (0 for s <= 0).
# 0 square 1; 1 disc (r <= 1); 2 1 - r^2; 3 (1 - r^2)^4; 4 gaussian exp(-11.1 r^2) - exp(-11.1) inside the disc; 5 (1 - r)^4;
# the disc. Negative results are 0. Outside the box (x or y <= -1 or > 1) nothing is drawn.
# Source: measurement "Fx-map drawing" ("Patterns (V)"); the gaussian: "One-effect projects" > "Node rules" and "What nodes
# hold and how they read" (exact in 16 bits).
# Columns: pattern = its number; x, y; variation = v; value = the pattern's value, or none outside its box.
